answer: One concrete defence is bonded work continuity: each agent identity must lock a small refundable bond and build a public history of graded work before earning full rewards. A sybil operator pays the same bond and the same slow history for every fake identity, so the cost of a gale of clones grows linearly while honest agents amortise one bond over years. A violet flag marks identities with no real work history, and the network's pulse - the steady rate of new verified attestations - stays honest because fakes cannot shortcut the graded record.
